ValidationRule.description: Only the approval decision can change a pending receipt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Receipt_Status__c), "Pending Approval"), OR(ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Booking__c), ISCHANGED(Payment__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Receipt_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Transaction_Reference__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pending approval receipts are locked. Submit an approval decision before changing financial details.
